title: CAVIA Mirror task context
hypothesis: A one-coordinate Mirror task context adapts faster or uses fewer bytes than CAVIA's unconstrained context at matched held-out quality.
mirror_coordinate: one task angle adapted from support examples

development.selection_metric: heldout nMSE, actual payload bytes, adaptation compute

fresh.reason: Direct angle context is an exact specificity control.

success_gate: Mirror improves over no-context, beats CAVIA/direct context at matched bytes or compute, and uses <50% independent task bytes.
failure_gate: Direct angle context aliases Mirror or Mirror misses held-out quality gate.
boundaries: no meta-training or natural few-shot claim
